glosses: to fight/force/make one's way through, to break/win/strike through
to shoot, to show, to push up (of plants)

examples.en: Tom fought his way through the crowd.
The sun broke through the clouds.

examples.text: Зимой через этот горный проход не пробиться.
examples.en: You can't get through the mountain pass in the winter.

examples.text: Они пробились сквозь гору и построили туннель.
examples.en: They dug through the mountain and built a tunnel.
